headline: There is a second
punch: Your adrenal glands run it, not your testes.

headline: Everyone tracks two molecules
body: So the entire conversation about androgens runs on testosterone and DHT. Both come from the classical pathway, both are mostly gonadal in origin, and both are what a standard panel measures. | There is an entire parallel class of androgens that your adrenal glands produce, that bind the same receptor with comparable potency, and that essentially nobody measures or discusses. In some people they carry more of the androgen load than testosterone does.
punch: Two molecules. A whole second family.

headline: So what are they?
body: The headline compound is **11-ketotestosterone**, usually written 11-KT. It binds the androgen receptor with potency comparable to testosterone itself, and it is manufactured by a completely different route. | The defining step is an adrenal enzyme called **CYP11B1**, which installs an oxygen atom at carbon 11 of the steroid backbone. Nothing in the classical testosterone pathway performs that step, which is what makes this a separate class rather than a variant.
punch: _A different enzyme, in a different gland._

headline: The route in one line
body: Adrenal androstenedione gets the 11-oxygen installed by CYP11B1 in the zona reticularis. The kidney then converts it onward. Then **AKR1C3**, working out in your fat, liver and immune cells, turns it into 11-ketotestosterone. | So the adrenal starts the molecule and your peripheral tissue finishes it. Your adipose tissue is not a bystander to this pathway, it is one of the places the activation step physically happens.
punch: Adrenal starts it. Your tissue finishes it.

headline: Barnard 2018
body: They measured how efficiently AKR1C3 handles each available substrate, which is the step that decides which pathway actually carries flux. The enzymatic efficiency of AKR1C3 is **8-fold greater** for the 11-oxygenated precursor than for classical androstenedione. | And **24-fold greater** than for the 5α-androstanedione route. The enzyme does not treat these as equivalent options. It strongly prefers the pathway nobody measures.

headline: Which flips the assumption
body: The classical pathway is not the efficient one at this step. It is the limited one. Their finding was that flux through the classical and 5α routes **is limited by low catalytic efficiency** at exactly this enzyme. | So when both substrates are available to the same enzyme in the same tissue, the 11-oxygenated route wins on kinetics. The side branch everyone ignores is the one the enzyme was apparently built for.
punch: The pathway nobody measures is the efficient one.

headline: What drives this pathway?
body: Classical androgens follow LH from your pituitary, which is why they track with testicular function and respond to things like hCG. 11-oxyandrogens follow **ACTH**, the same signal that drives cortisol. | So stress, sleep deprivation, low calorie intake and hypoglycaemia all raise the input to this pathway. And it runs a cortisol-like circadian rhythm, peaking in the morning and bottoming out overnight, which also means when you draw blood changes the answer.

headline: Insulin is the other lever
body: Insulin upregulates both **AKR1C3** and **SRD5A1**, the two peripheral activating enzymes in this pathway. So a post-prandial insulin spike acutely increases peripheral 11-ketotestosterone synthesis. | This is also the mechanism behind the androgen excess in PCOS: insulin-driven AKR1C3 in adipose tissue converting the 11-oxygenated precursor considerably faster than it converts the classical one.
punch: Your meal is an input to this pathway.

headline: Where it becomes dominant
body: In 21-hydroxylase deficient congenital adrenal hyperplasia, the blocked pathway shunts accumulated precursor through CYP11B1 and **11-ketotestosterone becomes the dominant circulating androgen**. | In Cushing's disease, chronically elevated ACTH drives CYP11B1 overexpression and 11-KT becomes a primary androgenic driver. These are the cases that prove the pathway can carry an entire androgen load on its own.
punch: In some people this IS their androgen system.

headline: One real limit
body: The 5α-reduced version, 11-KDHT, circulates at levels **20 to 89 fold lower** than DHT. The reason is structural: the C11-keto group sterically interferes with SRD5A1 recognising the molecule as a substrate. | So this pathway is highly efficient at the 11-KT step and distinctly inefficient at the step after it. It is not simply a parallel copy of the classical route running alongside, it has a different shape.
punch: Potent early. Inefficient at the last step.

headline: And you cannot get there
body: Taking exogenous DHT does not produce 11-KDHT. DHT lacks the carbon-11 oxygen that defines the entire class, and DHT is not a meaningful substrate for the adrenal enzyme that installs it. | That oxygen can only be added upstream, in the adrenal, on the androstenedione backbone, before or in parallel with 5α-reduction. There is no route that adds it afterwards to a finished molecule.
punch: _There is no shortcut into this pathway._

headline: What this changes
body: A standard panel measures testosterone and sometimes DHT. It does not measure 11-ketotestosterone, which binds the same receptor and in several documented conditions is the larger signal of the two. | Which means someone can show a low testosterone result and still carry a meaningful androgen load that nothing on their panel is reporting, driven by stress and insulin rather than by anything the panel tests.
punch: ==Your androgen panel is not measuring all your androgens.==
